coordinate_space: Percent of full image, origin top-left. Map all areas through the same image object-fit transform, including crop offsets; do not apply these percentages directly to an unrelated viewport. Portrait and wide layouts are separate.
placement: diameter_x is visible stone-disc diameter as % of full image width, diameter_y as % of full image height; these produce a physical circle. PNG has transparent padding: size sprite canvas from measured alpha_bbox_128 in validation.json (about90% occupied), centered at socket. Do not stretch into ellipses. Hide sprites when swapping to lit background, which already contains discs.
